source_claims.statement:
It probably should not be a great surprise to learn that mobile devices present some challenges for the Internet
architecture. The Internet was designed in an era when computers were large, immobile devices, and, while
the Internet's designers probably had some notion that mobile devices might appear in the future, it's fair to
assume it was not a top priority to accommodate them. Today, of course, mobile computers are everywhere,
notably in the form of laptops and smartphones, and increasingly in other forms, such as drones. In this
section, we will look at some of the challenges posed by the appearance of mobile devices and some of the
current approaches to accommodating them.
